status: Local code and validation complete; operational distributed rate limiting NOT ACTIVE; no deployment

rateLimiting.plannedScope: GET/HEAD for six read APIs and four relevant public pages; one combined 60-request/60-second fixed window per IP per Vercel region
rateLimiting.sharedIp: All users/tabs behind one public IP share the budget. About 15 active player tabs may consume the allowance without navigation.
rateLimiting.exclusions: Audio stream endpoints, external audio providers, admin routes and static assets
rateLimiting.response429: Native WAF Default (429) after activation only; local tests use a model, not the Vercel service
rateLimiting.nativeRetryAfter: Not guaranteed by the reviewed documentation; verify actual platform response after activation. Mock Retry-After is fixture behavior only.
rateLimiting.rationale: Native WAF can protect these paths without a redundant app IP limiter, SDK, Redis, Supabase counters or new paid infrastructure. Hobby only permits one rate-limit rule.

dashboardActionsRequired: Create the named project Firewall rule using the exact path regex and Method conditions in the runbook
Fixed Window, 60s, 60 requests, counting key IP only, exceeded action Default (429)
Review existing rules/bypasses and included Hobby usage; do not replace security rules or authorize paid usage automatically
Authorized operator must Save Rule, Review Changes, Publish, then verify 429/native headers and shared-IP behavior

refreshProtection.warmCache: Existing Next unstable_cache/Data Cache retained and shared where supported by Vercel
refreshProtection.inInstance: Global transient registry keyed by source coalesces concurrent cold loads, stale background refreshes and half-open recovery probes across route bundles in the same Node process
refreshProtection.acrossInstances: No atomic distributed lock or circuit breaker. Independent cold instances/regions can duplicate refreshes; the test suite intentionally demonstrates this.
refreshProtection.noUnsupportedClaims: Native ISR/image request collapsing is not claimed for these dynamic APIs. Metered Runtime Cache without documented atomic locks was not added.

timeoutsRetries.retryAfter: Honor seconds or HTTP date up to a five-minute cap; do not sleep past the remaining request budget
timeoutsRetries.cooldown: After 3 failed refreshes, 30 seconds. Provider Retry-After opens cooldown immediately for at least 30 seconds, up to 5 minutes. Instance-local, reset on validated success/process restart.

fallback.mechanism: Validated timestamped snapshots in existing Data Cache; no durable archival storage
fallback.timestamp: Only a successful validated refresh sets validatedAt. Cache reads and failures never extend it.
fallback.invalidData: Cannot replace the good snapshot. Expired good entries may remain internally but are rejected at the API boundary.
fallback.client: Now-playing origin expiry is sent in X-RPD-Valid-Until. A client deadline/visibility check clears old song information during HTTP or network failures.
fallback.unavailable: Original generic error shapes/status 500 retained; expired snapshots or open cooldown return 503 plus Retry-After. Now-playing retains its existing HTTP 200 neutral station label contract with expiry 0.
fallback.httpCaching: Cache-Control no-store avoids browser/CDN response caches extending snapshot lifetime; Next Data Cache remains enabled.
fallback.eviction: No available cached entry plus upstream outage yields unavailable content. Recovery may need a subsequent request after background revalidation.

fullRegression.includes: All existing Phase 1/3A tests and 25 Phase 3B tests

typecheck.note: Final production build also checked the latest TypeScript

verified: 40 concurrent cold HTTP homepage/program requests share one mocked upstream load
Persistent cache reused by a second production server

Browser song expiration while later metadata requests fail

validation.rateLimitCaveat: Local mock models the dashboard policy and simulated shared/regional counters. Native Vercel enforcement/headers were NOT tested or activated.
validation.upstreamSafety: Local mocks/fixtures only; no live upstream requests/load testing. Mock-generated fetch-cache files cleaned by harness.

remainingRisks: Distributed rate limiting is not active until an operator publishes and verifies the dashboard rule
Hobby combined-IP threshold may be too restrictive for shared public IPs and is regional, not globally atomic
Refresh locks/cooldown are process-local; simultaneous misses across instances remain possible
Data Cache is not a durable LKG archive and may be evicted
No native Vercel rate-limit/header or cross-region deployment verification was performed
